UPDATE session_orchestration_task
SET child_session_id = NULL,
    infrastructure_retry_count = infrastructure_retry_count + 1,
    status = CASE
        WHEN infrastructure_retry_count < ? THEN 'Planned'
        ELSE 'Failed'
    END,
    last_error = ?,
    updated_at = ?
WHERE id = ?
RETURNING status AS "status!: String"
